direction.orrery: CELESTIAL ENGRAVING. Delicate antiqued brass astronomical instruments temporarily traced in empty air. Each action becomes open analytical fine gold/ivory drafting strokes, interrupted construction arcs, compass teeth, tiny gauge ticks, pointer vanes and bright punched stars. Mostly negative space, a few thick wax-white focal strokes to survive at 85px. Hand-cut copperplate instruments of a medieval astrologer. NOT a coin or static circle around everything, tailoring the diagram's envelope to its trajectory. Metal warm brass, cream, occasional muted element-colored tracer. No wide glows.
direction.vitrail: SHATTERED CATHEDRAL GLASS. Each action is a sculptural flying cluster of uneven, handcut translucent jewel panes with midnight lead cames. Concentrate ruby, amber, teal, cobalt, amethyst glass locally, a dominant color per skill. Directional facets and broken triangular splinters with sharp pearl rim lights and pale reflections. Asymmetrical, large bold pieces and holes open to the portrait behind. A tangible flat medieval stained-glass artwork breaking apart into space. NO intact windows, NO enclosing panel, no frame, no circles around each sprite, no glows.
direction.wraith: PHANTOM FLAME. Dark-fantasy ethereal volumetric VFX, high-end hand-painted realistic, loose and fiercely directional. Long sinuous wisps of luminous mist flow into and out of each gesture, with lost-and-found edges, thin trails fading to genuinely clear alpha and a small incandescent core. Subtle silvery-blue ghostlight with distinct warm fire, glacial cyan, venom green, crimson curses and soft sage healing accents as appropriate. Flowing organic vapor, flame lick filaments, ember motes. NO outlines, NO circles or glyphs, NO jewels, NO architecture. Shapes read in 85px.

gridPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game art asset, an exactly 4 columns x 4 rows transparent sprite atlas containing SIXTEEN deliberately different high quality isolated SKILL EFFECTS. SQUARE composition, regular aligned grid, equal square cells. Each entry is a frozen moment of an action over a gothic dark-fantasy portrait card (portrait NOT depicted). Each sprite fills only its own central 72% with generous fully transparent gutters so the atlas can be precisely sliced. No touching adjacent cells, no grid drawn, no borders, no labels, no characters, no background, no checkerboard. Strong readable central gesture, negative spaces. NOT inventory icons, not badges, no repeated surrounding medallions. All 16 in one art direction: {direction} Exact contents by ROW, left to right: Row 1 = {1} | {2} | {3} | {4}. Row 2 = {5} | {6} | {7} | {8}. Row 3 = {9} | {10} | {11} | {12}. Row 4 = {13} | {14} | {15} | {16}. Keep all four rows and columns equally spaced, transparent alpha through all open space.
